_meta.description: Run-structure meta constants for Slay the Spire V2.3.4, transcribed from the sts_lightspeed reference implementation (behavior spec) plus wiki text where noted.

conventions.citations: file:line ranges refer to files under referenceRoot unless prefixed with wiki/
conventions.rolls: rng.random(N) returns a uniform integer in [0, N]; rng.random(a, b) returns a uniform integer in [a, b]; rng.random() returns a float in [0, 1)
conventions.weights: exact fractions are given as { "n": numerator, "d": denominator }

seedAlphabet.stringFromSeed: repeated uint64 divmod by 35, remainder indexes chars, digits emitted least-significant first then string reversed

digitValue.note: the letter O itself maps to 23, aliasing N ('N'-'A'+10 == 'O'-'A'+9 == 23); letters after O are shifted down by one so the alphabet skips O

prng.type: xorshift128+ seeded via two murmurhash3 finalizer passes

murmurHash3.algorithm: x ^= x>>33; x *= 0xFF51AFD7ED558CCD; x ^= x>>33; x *= 0xC4CEB9FE1A85EC53; x ^= x>>33

prng.nextLong: s1 = seed0; s0 = seed1; seed0 = s0; s1 ^= s1 << 23; seed1 = s1 ^ s0 ^ (s1 >> 17) ^ (s0 >> 26); return seed1 + s0
prng.boundedNextLong: rejection sampling: do { bits = nextLong() >>> 1; value = bits % n; } while (int64(bits - value + n - 1) < 0)
prng.randomIntRange: random(range) = nextInt(range + 1) and increments counter; random(start, end) = start + nextInt(end - start + 1)

counter.increment: every random* wrapper call increments counter by 1
counter.restoreByTargetCounter: Random(seed, targetCounter) replays targetCounter calls of random(999)
counter.setCounter: setCounter(target) advances using randomBoolean() until counter == target

javaRandom.use: java.util.Random LCG used only for Collections.shuffle of pools/lists, seeded from an sts Random's nextLong()/randomLong()
javaRandom.shuffle: Fisher-Yates from the end: for i=size..2: swap(arr[i-1], arr[rnd.nextInt(i)])

mathUtilRng.note: in the real game this stream is time-seeded; lightspeed pins it to seed-897897 (comment: 'uses a time based seed -_-'). initFromSave sets it to Random(seed, 0)

notSeededAtConstruction.note: assigned at battle init from Random(seed + floorNum)

perFloorReseedOnMapTransition.where: transitionToMapNode after ++floorNum; also enterBossTreasureRoom and the A20 act-3 second-boss transition

rngStreams.cardRngActTransitionCounterJump: on transitionToAct: if cardRng.counter < 250 setCounter(250); else if < 500 setCounter(500); else if < 750 setCounter(750)
rngStreams.relicPoolShuffles: at run start the 5 relic pools (common, uncommon, rare, shop, boss) are each shuffled with java.Collections.shuffle(java.Random(relicRng.nextLong())), consuming 5 relicRng longs in that order

persistedCounters.note: neowRng, shuffleRng, aiRng, monsterHpRng, mathUtilRng counters are not persisted

sources: src/game/GameContext.cpp:48 (mathUtilRng(seed-897897), comment 'uses a time based seed -_-')

rarityRoll.resolution: roll < rareChance -> RARE; roll < rareChance + uncommonChance -> UNCOMMON; else COMMON
rarityRoll.nlothsGift: if room != REST and player has NLOTHS_GIFT: rareChance *= 3

rarePity.note: factor is ADDED to the d100 roll, so lower factor means higher rare chance; floor -40

cardRewards.duplicates: reroll card id (not rarity) until not a duplicate of earlier cards in this reward
cardRewards.prismaticShard: if held, cards are drawn from the any-color pools via getAnyColorCard (which burns one extra cardRng.randomLong() per card)

upgradedCardChance.roll: cardRng.randomBoolean(chance) per card; RARE cards are never auto-upgraded
upgradedCardChance.eggRelics: MOLTEN_EGG (attack) / TOXIC_EGG (skill) / FROZEN_EGG (power) upgrade via previewObtainCard when the upgrade roll fails

cardRewards.prayerWheel: adds a second full card reward to normal-monster combat rewards

unknownRoom.thresholds: monsterSize = int(monsterChance*100); shopSize = monsterSize + (lastRoomWasShop ? 0 : int(shopChance*100)); treasureSize = shopSize + int(treasureChance*100); idx < monsterSize -> MONSTER, < shopSize -> SHOP, < treasureSize -> TREASURE, else EVENT
unknownRoom.lastRoomWasShopRule: shop share is 0 if the previous room was a shop (but shopChance still escalates/resets normally)

escalation.monster: +0.10 when not chosen, reset to 0.10 when chosen
escalation.shop: +0.03 when not chosen, reset to 0.03 when chosen
escalation.treasure: +0.02 when not chosen, reset to 0.02 when chosen

unknownRoom.tinyChest: counter per relic: on the 4th ? room (value == 3) force TREASURE and reset counter to 0, else increment; forced treasure bypasses the roll but escalation/reset still applies afterwards based on choice
unknownRoom.juzuBracelet: a MONSTER result is converted to EVENT (monsterChance still resets to 0.10)
unknownRoom.ssserpentHead: entering an EVENT room grants 50 gold (relicsOnEnterRoom)

shrineChance.fallbacks: shrine branch with empty shrine+oneTime lists falls back to getEvent (or INVALID if events also empty); getEvent with no eligible events falls back to getShrine
shrineChance.shrinePoolComposition: eligible shrines = act shrine list + one-time special events passing canAddOneTimeEvent; uniform pick eventRngCopy.random(len-1)

ancestorGap.note: MIN/MAX_ANCESTOR_GAP declared in Map.cpp but not referenced by lightspeed's generation code; the common-ancestor check is getCommonAncestor which only inspects the immediate parent row

paths.secondStartRule: path index 1 rerolls its start column while it equals the first path's start
paths.step: newX = curX + randRange(-1..1 clamped at edges); then parent-loop randomizer; then clamp against neighbors' existing edges; final row (y=14) always connects to x=3 (boss)
paths.edgeFilter: duplicate first-row edges to the same destination are removed

roomProportions.countExpr: count = round(totalRoomCount * chance); remainder of unassigned array filled with MONSTER

mapGen.row13Quirk: row 13 (restRowBug) nodes are counted as unassigned but NOT added to counts.total, so proportional counts are computed over a total that excludes row 13

assignment.shuffle: unassigned room array Fisher-Yates shuffled with mapRng.nextInt (not java Random)

vetoes.rest: not allowed at y <= 4 or y >= 13
vetoes.event: vetoed only if a sibling already has EVENT
vetoes.monster: vetoed only if a sibling already has MONSTER
vetoes.shopRestEliteOther: vetoed if any parent (previous row via edges) or sibling has the same room

assignment.rowPropagation: rows 0 and 8 only seed sibling/parent masks; rows 7 and 13 assign rooms but do not propagate masks to the next row
assignment.fallback: a node that matches no assignable room becomes MONSTER

burningElite.when: act 1 always; acts 2-3 only while the emerald key is not owned
burningElite.pick: mapRng.random(eliteRoomCount - 1) over elite rooms in row-major order
